# The Adda Labs (TAL)

> TAL, short for The Adda Labs, is a team in Mumbai and Navi Mumbai, India. We help businesses that grow on enquiries turn more of them into customers, using a website people can find, regular posts, and AI follow-ups that reply for you. We work with businesses in India and abroad.

- Legal name: TAL Consulting LLP (LLPIN ACZ-3000), Mumbai, India
- Founder: Rohan Tiwarekar
- Contact: rohan@theaddalabs.com, or book a call at https://www.theaddalabs.com/call
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/112236854/
- Not to be confused with ADDA (the housing society app) or other "Adda" brands

## What we do

- Website design for small businesses, and Google Maps (Google Business Profile, reviews)
- WhatsApp auto-reply and lead follow-up: replies in seconds, follow-ups, booking
- Social media management: posts, reels and ads that bring people in
- Positioning and offer design
- AI chatbots for WhatsApp and websites

## How we work

We start with where a business loses customers: enquiries nobody finds, replies that come too late, posts that bring no one in. Then we build the fix and hand it over. Our team has done this work for brands like Taiwan Excellence, Cosmic Byte, Atomberg and Pilgrim.
